speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You are here for sudden-onset lower back pain radiating down your leg; have you noticed if this pain travels past your knee or is accompanied by numbness or weakness in your foot?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar Disc Herniation (likely L5 or S1 radiculopathy).

I have reviewed your report of sudden onset back pain while exercising that radiates to the foot. To confirm the level and severity of nerve compression, can you tell me if you have any specific weakness, such as difficulty lifting your big toe or standing on your toes?
